title: Autonomous DAG stem-cell and answer generalizer
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for compiling tasks (things to do) and task objects across seven Kahn-wave DAG profiles, autonomously lifting discrete decision forks into answer manifolds, vaporizing ephemeral CLI harness workspaces, recovering from canary blueprint drift and computing causal Shapley step credits.
boundaries: Workers remain stateless claimants of Tessera tasks (things to do) and never create a rival task, scheduler or policy authority.
Every materialized CLI harness workspace and subprocess join directory is unconditionally deleted in finally so ephemeral_retained equals zero.

Discrete worker strategy forks are generalized into parameterized task objects with zero human scalar prompts, reserving blocked strictly for missing external credentials or human-only NGO policy sign-off.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

value.lets_workers: Compile tasks (things to do) into seven verified Kahn-wave DAG profiles (linear_waterfall, hedged_staggered_dag, parallel_first_verified_race_dag, diamond_scatter_gather_dag, quorum_adjudication_dag, voi_branch_and_bound_dag and hybrid_staged_adaptive_dag), lift discrete (A, B) forks into {A, B, A (+) B} manifold task objects with VCG shadow pricing and zero human scalar prompts, materialize and vaporize isolated muse, nanomuse, opencode, pi and codex workspaces, recover Rung-0 blueprints from drift via canary demotion and isolate root-cause step faults via exact coalition Shapley credits.

Audit Rung-0 blueprints with canary probes (demoting v1 to v2 on schema drift), compute exact coalition Shapley step credits and enforce AST and domain-agnostic naming gates.
